title: Seasons and weather
examples: What is the weather like today?
What should I wear when it is rainy?

explain.say: Look at the pictures. We learn about the four seasons. They are spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

draw.text: Four Seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter

explain.say: Now look! Here it is in 3D: Earth's tilt and the seasons. Can you see the sun and the tilted axis? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Spring is when little flowers start to grow. The weather can be a little wet sometimes.
Summer is warm and sunny for playing outside. You might see bright sunshine every day.
Autumn is when the leaves on the trees change color. They often fall down to the ground.

draw.text: Autumn: Leaves change color, fall down.

explain.say: Winter is cold and sometimes snowy. We need warm clothes when it is very chilly.
When you visit the park, you see colorful leaves on the ground. That is autumn's changing colors. The falling leaves show the season changing.

faq.q: What is the difference between seasons and weather?
faq.a: Seasons are big changes that happen over many months. Weather is what it is like outside right now.
asks: Are seasons the same as weather?
What is the difference between the two?

faq.q: Does it always rain in spring?
faq.a: No, spring can have different weather. It can be sunny, rainy, or a little bit of everything.

faq.q: What is the best season for swimming?
faq.a: Summer is usually the warmest season. It is great for playing near the water.
asks: When is it warm enough to swim?
Which season is best for the beach?

faq.q: Do I need a coat in autumn?
faq.a: Yes, autumn can get cool. A light jacket or coat is a good idea to wear.
asks: Should I wear a coat in fall?
Is it cold enough for a jacket in autumn?

faq.q: What is the weather word for cloudy?
faq.a: Cloudy means the sky has lots of clouds but it is not raining. It is just covered up.
asks: Is cloudy the same as overcast?

facts: The four seasons are spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
In autumn, many trees lose their leaves.
Summer weather is usually warm and sunny.
Winter can bring snow and very cold temperatures.

quiz.say: If the leaves on the trees are changing color and falling down, what season is it?
quiz.show: Leaves changing color and falling down?
quiz.why: The changing and falling leaves are a main sign of autumn.

wrong.0: Winter is when it gets cold and sometimes snowy.
wrong.2: Spring is when new flowers start to bloom.
wrong.3: Summer is usually when the sun is strongest.

quiz.say: You see bright sunshine and warm temperatures every day. Which season is this?
quiz.why: Warm and bright sunshine are the best parts of summer.

wrong.0: Spring can be a little bit wet when the flowers grow.
wrong.1: Autumn is when the leaves start to turn colors.
wrong.2: Winter is when it is cold and sometimes snowy.

quiz.say: If the weather forecast says it is cold and sometimes snowy, what season might it be?
quiz.why: Snow and cold weather are common signs of winter.

wrong.0: Summer weather is much warmer than this.
wrong.1: Spring is usually warming up after the cold time.
wrong.2: Autumn is when the leaves are changing color, not always snowy.
